title: Innate Pharma releases its 2027 financial calendar
body_markdown:
** Thu, 11/26/2026 - 07:00


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”) today releases its 2027 financial calendar:


- **March 31, 2027:** Publication of 2026 financial statements
- **May 12, 2027:** Publication of revenue and cash position for 1Q2027
- **May 19, 2027:** Annual General Meeting of Shareholders
- **September 16, 2027:** Publication of half year financial statements
- **November 3, 2027:** Publication of revenue and cash position for 3Q2027


This financial calendar is provided for information purposes and is subject to change. Financial reports are released before the opening of trading on Euronext Paris and Nasdaq.


All corporate information, such as the Company’s financial statements and corporate presentations, is available on the[Investors section](https://innatepharma2021ir.q4web.com/English/investors/overview/default.aspx) on the[Company website](https://www.innate-pharma.com/) .
